scope: NCAA regular-season FBS games; game margin and total only; NFL excluded
hypothesis: Sample-aware priors and recency weighting describe the current NCAA team better than an immediate fixed current-season weight; shorter windows may help after season boundaries.

excluded_seasons.2020: Predeclared COVID schedule discontinuity; separate descriptive report only

validation_folds: One season ahead: parameters chosen only from earlier seasons; weekly prediction origins use inputs available before that origin. Refit on development + earlier validation seasons, never later seasons.

holdout.reason: A future complete season is needed to test the early-season transition; historical outcomes have already been inspected in this repo.

candidates.method: Exact frozen build_game_models trailing 12 / 80-20 / minimum 5 comparator
Uniform trailing 4; common eligibility still requires 5 preceding games/team
All available current-season games; previous-season mean prior with k=2 pseudo-games
All available current-season games; previous-season mean prior with k=4 pseudo-games
All available current-season games; previous-season mean prior with k=8 pseudo-games
Trailing 24 games, exponential game-age half-life 2, prior-season multiplier 0.5
Trailing 24 games, exponential game-age half-life 4, prior-season multiplier 0.5
Trailing 24 games, exponential game-age half-life 8, prior-season multiplier 0.5

candidate_parameters: k/half-life/window values are preregistered search candidates, not validated coefficients or production requirements. No second round of searching after the holdout.
common_forecast_formula: home=(home weighted points scored + away weighted points allowed)/2; away=(away weighted points scored + home weighted points allowed)/2. Keep home advantage and opponent-adjustment architecture fixed to Champion for this isolated weighting experiment.
shrink_formula: (n_current*mean_current + k*mean_previous_season)/(n_current+k); if prior unavailable use a pooled prior learned strictly from earlier development data, flag that fallback; if no current data use prior with uncertainty disclosed
decay_formula: raw_weight=2^(-game_age/half_life)*(0.5 if previous season else 1); discard observations older than previous season; normalize within team
eligibility: Same games with 5 valid preceding results per team; exclude ambiguous IDs, non-FBS/nonregular games, missing kickoff timezone or missing as-of input provenance. Report exclusions and candidate missingness before scoring. Forecast at the latest 08:00 America/New_York origin strictly before kickoff; source captured_at and result_available_at must both precede origin.
benchmark: Pooled prior-season mean total and pooled home margin estimated only from earlier development data; additionally report matched market spread/total MAE/RMSE only when exact decision-time quotes have trustworthy capture timestamps
selection: Select at most one challenger separately for margin and total by mean chronological validation RMSE; require improvement in at least 2 of 3 validation seasons; ties within 0.01 points choose simpler uniform method, then longer window, then lower prior strength. Freeze selected parameters and implementation hashes before 2027-08-01.
uncertainty: 2000 paired seven-day-block bootstrap replicates, fixed seed 20261003; resample all games in each block together; 97.5% intervals for 2 co-primary outcomes; sensitivity with 14-day blocks and team-cluster jackknife; no independent-row bootstrap
acceptance: At least 0.25 points holdout RMSE improvement against Champion and 95% familywise paired interval excludes 0 for that outcome; not worse than simple benchmark; no stage worsens MAE by more than 0.5 points. If sample gates or provenance fail => INSUFFICIENT; no extensions or threshold changes. Any production promotion separately requires Travis.
probability_metrics: Not an automatic probability challenger. A later separately registered distribution/calibration study must evaluate Brier/logloss/reliability on exact matched contracts, including push/void handling. Projection improvement alone does not validate betting probabilities.
forbidden: changing production models or Today ranking
ROI/CLV without exact archived decision/closing prices
next_input_gate: Archive versioned public raw schedules/results and game-level features with retrieval time/source URL/content hash/team-ID mapping/schema; verify historical releases and as-of semantics offline before any fitting. Public release access may be free but is not invoked by this scaffold. No provider calls or paid inputs.
deferred_features: Opponent-adjusted ridge, feature-specific stabilization, verified coaching/QB/roster breaks require new versions after provenance/data availability is established; do not multiply the current candidate grid.
